title: VPN Network Traffic Sampling Benchmark
summary: A benchmarking framework comparing ML and DL sampling techniques (SMOTE, WGAN-GP, CTGAN, etc.) to address class imbalance in VPN network traffic datasets. It calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and conditional sampling in traffic_utils/sdv_samplers.py as one of the generative oversampling methods evaluated.
